components.name: Spine, stamped (במניין)
components.description: A leather spine with two gold bands and a gold title block: the mark of a prayer said במניין or a day of learning.
components.css: .ds-spine { position: relative; display: inline-block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 16px; height: 42px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--hue); } .ds-spine-done::before, .ds-spine-done::after { content: ''; position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-spine-done::before { inset: 6px 0; border-block: 3px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-spine-done::after { top: 12px; inset-inline: 3px; height: 9px; background: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); }

components.name: Shelf of states
components.description: The five states by shape on one board, with today's gold bar: stamped, plain (ביחידות), half-height (ק״ש בלבד), dashed (due, not marked), gap (did not apply).
components.css: .ds-shelf { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; padding: 0 4px 9px; } .ds-shelf::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 5px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--shelf-board, #b08d57); } .ds-slot { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: 16px; height: 42px; } .ds-today::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: calc(100% + 6px); height: 3px; background: var(--today, #a87a1f); } .ds-sp { position: relative; display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 16px; height: 42px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--hue); } .ds-sp-done::before, .ds-sp-done::after { content: ''; position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-sp-done::before { inset: 6px 0; border-block: 3px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-sp-done::after { top: 12px; inset-inline: 3px; height: 9px; background: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-sp-shema { height: 21px; } .ds-sp-unmarked { border: 1.5px dashed var(--hue); background: none; }

components.name: Attendance control
components.description: The 44pt במניין | ביחידות | ק״ש בלבד control under each prayer on היום; a selected במניין is the prayer's deep leather with gold lettering in a gold frame.
components.css: .ds-attendance { display: flex; height: 44px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--app-fill, rgba(118,118,128,0.12)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Hebrew', 'Arial Hebrew', sans-serif; } .ds-attendance button { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; background-clip: padding-box; color: var(--app-label, #1c1c1e); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-attendance button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--app-raised, #ffffff); color: var(--app-on-raised, #1c1c1e); font-weight: 600; } .ds-attendance .ds-att-minyan[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--hue-deep); color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-attendance .ds-att-minyan[aria-pressed='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); border-radius: 5px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-attendance button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-attendance button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8a5a12); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Leather band
components.description: The header from the status bar through the date line: round gold chevrons, the gold large title, a holiday chip, the parchment date line, and the fine gold double rule.

components.css: .ds-band { background: var(--shell, #2b2320); padding: 8px 0 12px; position: relative; } .ds-band::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 16px; bottom: 3px; height: 5px; border-block: 1.5px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); border-bottom-width: 0.5px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-band-tools { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-chev { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--stamp, #e2c27a) 14%, transparent); color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-chev:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-band-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-band-title h1 { margin: 0; color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); font-family: 'Frank Ruhl Libre', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip { padding: 4px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--stamp, #e2c27a); border-radius: 16px; color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); font: 500 15px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-band-date { margin: 4px 0 8px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--on-shell, #e8d7ad); font: 15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-card { margin: 12px 16px; padding: 6px 16px 7px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); } .ds-row-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 44px; } .ds-name { margin: 0; font-family: 'Frank Ruhl Libre', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 26px; color: var(--app-label, #1c1c1e); } .ds-meta { margin: 0; font: 15px/18px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; color: var(--app-label-secondary, #6c6c70); }

components.name: Round check
components.description: A full-row check (תפילין, טלית, למדתי): a 26pt ring that fills with the card's deep leather and shows a gold tick.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--app-label, #1c1c1e); font: 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8a5a12); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ring { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1.5px solid var(--app-label-secondary, #6c6c70); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-check[aria-checked='true'] .ds-ring { border: 0; background: var(--hue-deep); }

components.name: Period segment (dressed)

components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; height: 44px; margin: 12px 16px 0; padding: 2px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--app-fill, rgba(118,118,128,0.12)); } .ds-seg button { flex: 1 1 0; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--app-label, #1c1c1e); font: 500 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--switch, #2b2320); color: var(--stamp, #e2c27a); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--switch, #2b2320), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--stamp, #e2c27a); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8a5a12); }

narrative.overview:
Every prayer is a sefer on a shelf, bound in its own leather, and a prayer במניין earns its gold stamp. The app reads as a beit midrash bookcase seen in daylight (or by lamplight in dark): one dark leather band across the top carrying a gold large title, then plain iOS grouped cards on the system ground, each row ending in a short shelf of spines standing on a flat board. The shelf repeats as the signature on every tab: seven spines per prayer on היום, one shelf per prayer per week in לוח, and the period's shelf per prayer in סטטיסטיקה.

The system is native first. Ionic React runs in iOS mode, the body face is the phone's own font, cards, lists, segmented controls and the tab bar are iOS grouped-style, and every size is in rem against the phone's Text Size so Dynamic Type still scales it (1rem is 17pt at the default size). The book world lives only in the leathers, the gold, the spines and the board; nothing else is ornamented.

Marks are large enough to read at arm's length on an iPhone SE: spines are 16pt wide and 42pt tall, prayer names 24pt, the marking control 44pt. Colour is flat throughout. The world rejects the habit-tracker vocabulary of green checks, flames and heat grids, and the previous version's small marks.
keyCharacteristics: Five fixed leathers, one per prayer and one for תורה, identical on every tab.
Gold on a mark means במניין (or a day of learning) and nothing else.
A spine's state is its shape: stamped, plain, half-height, dashed outline, or a gap.
One dark leather band holds the toolbar, gold title and date line, closed by a fine gold double rule, in both appearances.
Light and dark follow the phone, with an override in הגדרות.
Flat colour: no grain, no gradient fills, no shadows.

rules.name: The Gold Means במניין Rule
rules.body: On a mark, gold means the prayer was said במניין, or on the תורה shelf that a day of learning was logged, and nothing else. ביחידות and ק״ש בלבד never carry gold on a spine or a selected segment. The listed exceptions, which sit around the marks and not on them, are gold-toned by design: the leather band's title and double rule, today's bar, and the gilded accent (the selected tab, holidays and the פרשה, the learning "+", the ticks of the checks).

rules.name: The One Leather Rule
rules.body: A prayer's leather is the same on every tab and every surface: its spine, its selected במניין segment, its key in כל הזמנים. Never recolour a prayer for a context, and never give ביחידות or ק״ש בלבד a prayer's leather in the trend columns; they take the plain shell (light) or board (dark) colour.

rules.name: The Leather Band Holds Rule
rules.body: The header and the status bar are leather in light and in dark alike, so the installed app's status bar always matches the band.

rules.name: The Book Face Rule
rules.body: Frank Ruhl Libre 700 is for large titles, prayer names on היום and the big numbers in סטטיסטיקה only. Row names in לוח and סטטיסטיקה, and everything else, are in the phone's font.

rules.name: The Readable At Arm's Length Rule
rules.body: Every line read while marking is at least 15pt, and nothing but the tab labels is under 13pt. All sizes are rem fractions of 17 (for example `calc(15rem / 17)`), never px, so the phone's Text Size setting scales them. "ק״ש בלבד" is never shortened.

rules.name: The Flat Leather Rule
rules.body: Colour is flat: no grain, no gradient fill, no drop shadow, on spines, boards, cards or the band.

dos: **Do** show a prayer's state by the spine's shape (stamped, plain, half-height, dashed, gap), never by colour alone.
**Do** keep gold on marks for במניין and days of learning only; the band's title and rule, today's bar and the gilded accent are the listed exceptions.
**Do** give every tap target at least 44pt in both directions; when the drawn control is smaller (the 34px header chevrons), extend its hit area to 44pt.
**Do** set every size in rem as a fraction of 17 so Text Size scales it, with marking text at 15pt or more.
**Do** read leathers through the row's hue class and the `--hue` / `--hue-deep` variables, so one component serves every prayer.
**Do** keep the header and status bar strip in Leather Shell in both appearances.
**Do** honour reduce motion: the stamp, the press scale and colour transitions all stop.
donts: **Don't** put gold on a ביחידות or ק״ש בלבד spine or selected segment.
**Don't** tool ביחידות in a darker leather or any other spine that matches במניין's shape; the owner rejected that because it differed only in colour.
**Don't** add grain, gradient fills or shadows to spines, boards, cards or the band.
**Don't** use green checks, flames or heat grids for progress; progress is spines on a shelf.
**Don't** set row names in לוח or סטטיסטיקה, or any body text, in Frank Ruhl Libre.
**Don't** shrink spines below the sizes above or abbreviate "ק״ש בלבד" to fit.
